meta.title: Bulk / Line-wise Counter Offer: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and repeat the action as a Buyer in the same tenant.
Verify role-specific refusal or absence of Bulk / Line-wise Counter Offer availability.
Execute bulk counters with line-wise accept/reject and automatic price propagation.
Verify tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted this capability.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and repeat the action as a Buyer in the same tenant.; Verify role-specific refusal or absence of Bulk / Line-wise Counter Offer availability.; Execute bulk counters with line-wise accept/reject and automatic price propagation.; Verify tenant RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted this capability.

steps.note: Open a prepared event with vendor bids so counter-offer controls are available.
Inspect the current user's event actions, including whether bulk counter-offer is offered.
Check the current session's menu availability, though the catalog cannot establish which RBAC role this session has.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same tenant, then verify that Bulk / Line-wise Counter Offer is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available and executable for the Buyer, including line-wise accept/reject and automatic price propagation
